heading: INT. SKYLARK ROLLER RINK - AFTER HOURS

units.text: INT. SKYLARK ROLLER RINK - AFTER HOURS
Disco ball dead.
Neon half-lit.
The rink floor is a lacquered oval of scuffs.
In the center, a card table.
Five folding chairs.
Five people.
All in shoes, none on skates.
CORNELIUS "SLIM" DUBREUIL, 60s, tall, silver pompadour, dinner jacket from another decade, deals cards like he is laying bricks.
MARISOL AGUILERA, 30s, red lipstick, tailored black jumpsuit, counts chips without looking.
BIG TEDDY KOWALSKI, 50s, shoulders like a vending machine, a toothpick in his teeth.
"MOUSE" PETROVA, 20s, hood up, sneakers untied, fingers drumming the table.
And DETECTIVE HARUKI SATO, 40s, plain suit, plain tie, wedding ring, a face that gives away nothing at all.
Nobody leaves the table till the pot's been called. House rule.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: Since when does a roller rink have house rules?
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Since I bought it, Marisol.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: It's a good rink. Smells like feet and popcorn.
units.name: BIG TEDDY

units.text: Smells like money. Slim, you cut the deck twice.
units.name: MOUSE

units.text: I cut it once, Mouse. Your eyes are tired.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: My eyes are fine. Haruki, what do you say?
units.name: MOUSE

units.text: I say I came to play cards.
units.name: SATO

units.text: You came to listen, Haruki. We all know it.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Marisol, if I wanted to listen, I'd have brought a wire.
units.name: SATO

units.text: Wire. Heh.
units.name: BIG TEDDY

units.text: Ante up, children.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: Slim, who's the sixth chair for?
units.name: MOUSE

units.text: There's no sixth chair.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: There's a chair. Right there. By the door.
units.name: MOUSE

units.text: That's a coat rack, Mouse.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: Mouse is right, Slim. That's a chair.
units.name: SATO

units.text: Why would there be a sixth chair, Slim?
units.name: BIG TEDDY

units.text: For whoever's coming to collect.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: Collect what?
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Teddy. Tell her.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: Slim, I don't...
units.name: BIG TEDDY

units.text: Tell her what you sold me.
units.name: SLIM

units.text: Marisol, I never meant...
units.name: BIG TEDDY

units.text: Teddy.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: It was the Bay Street job. They knew the route. I gave them the route.
units.name: BIG TEDDY

units.text: Oh, no.
units.name: MOUSE

units.text: Nobody move.
units.name: SATO

units.text: The front doors of the rink swing wide.
Light floods in.
